data.name: Assault Commander RTS
data.detailed_description:
Assault Commander RTS is a fast-paced real-time military strategy game. Built on the foundations of the turn-based classic Assault Commander Rearmed, the battlefield now runs in real time: raise your base, field your army, and outfight the enemy in isometric 3D, backed by a player profile, a research system, and a challenging computer opponent.

Fight through the single-player campaign on 6 difficulty levels.

Command your forces across more than 30 missions. Primary objectives are randomized per playthrough, and optional side objectives, random battlefield events, and escalating enemy waves make every attempt play out differently. As you progress, you will face larger maps and command more units and buildings.

Choose your side in a war between two distinct factions.

Each faction has its own units, buildings, defenses, super weapons, and power-ups. One fields a conventional combined-arms army built on firepower and reach. The other wages sensor war with jammers, stealth fields, decoys, mine belts, and swarms of cheap, expendable machines.

Command the units of modern warfare on land, at sea, and in the air.

Field more than 60 unit types: infantry, tanks, artillery, warships, submarines, helicopters, bombers, and drones, alongside specialists such as sniper teams, electronic-warfare jammers, infiltrators, kamikaze drones, and VTOL transports.

Build your base and hold it.

Construct factories, airfields, shipyards, and power plants, then ring them with walls, gates, bunkers, sentry towers, anti-armor guns, and anti-air emplacements. Buildings and bridges are destructible, so every defensive line can be broken or bypassed.

Run a war economy.

Gather raw materials from the map, process them into Resources, Alloy, and Supply, and keep your power grid running under fire. Protect your collectors, and raid the enemy's economy to starve their war machine.

Unleash super weapons.

Call in cruise missile salvos, ballistic missile strikes, and airdrops behind enemy lines, and shield your base with super defenses that can shut down an entire air assault.

Research upgrades and deploy tactical packages.

Earn coins in missions and spend them between battles to research improvements for your units and buildings. In the field, deploy more than 30 tactical packages to repair your forces, boost their firepower, or fortify your position at the decisive moment.

Adapt to the battlefield.

A full day/night cycle changes sight ranges, weapon effectiveness, and stealth. Fight across temperate, snow, and desert theaters, and use fog of war, terrain, and high ground to your advantage.

Prove yourself in Conflict mode.

Turn any skirmish into a recorded, scored match. Play Ranked to move your Conflict Rating and climb the online leaderboards, or Casual to experiment freely. Then study the debrief, chase personal bests, and build your commander's career. Share a Match Code to challenge others on the exact same battlefield.

Sharpen your skills in training games.

Play standalone maps against the computer with up to 5 players, team colors, and alliances. These games do not affect your profile, so you can freely practice and try out units and strategies.

Thank you for your continuous support and reviews. Please don't forget to wishlist. Gameplay videos, trailer, and community content are coming soon.

data.short_description: Assault Commander RTS is a fast-paced real-time military strategy game. Fight a 30+ mission campaign with two distinct factions, build and defend your base, command land, air, and naval forces, unleash super weapons, and climb the ranked Conflict leaderboards.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 768 MB available space
